"Makhani Karahi is basically a Punjabi-style hybrid between butter chicken (makhani) and karahi chicken—rich, tomato-butter based, but with the bold masala kick of karahi."

Method

Marinate chicken (optional, 30 min). Sear in a pan until lightly browned, not fully cooked. Set aside.

Make karahi masala: Dry roast coriander, cumin, and red chilies. Grind coarsely. This spice is what keeps the dish from turning into generic butter chicken.

Prepare base:

Heat butter + oil in a heavy karahi/wok.

Add onions, sauté until golden.

Add ginger-garlic paste, cook till raw smell goes.

Add tomato purée, salt, red chili powder. Cook down until the oil separates—this step is critical for depth.

Add cashew paste/cream: Stir in cashew paste, let it thicken.

Bring in chicken: Add browned chicken, coat well in the masala. Sprinkle in the fresh karahi spice blend. Cook until chicken is done.

Finish with makhani touch: Add cream, kasuri methi, and a touch of honey/sugar. Simmer a couple of minutes until glossy.

Garnish & serve: Top with coriander, extra cream swirl, maybe even a small pat of butter for drama. Serve with naan or jeera rice.
